projects.title: Dispatch Manager
projects.description: An enterprise-grade, real-time web application for streamlining field service operations, triaging incoming tickets, and tracking team performance.
projects.longDescription: Engineered for Mountaintop Cable TV Networks, this system replaced manual spreadsheet-based dispatch workflows with a real-time platform. Features include Role-Based Access Control with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, bi-directional Google Sheets sync via Apps Script, advanced analytics dashboards, and spreadsheet-style bulk ticket creation.
highlights: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with row-level security
Bi-Directional Google Sheets Sync via Apps Script
Advanced Analytics Dashboard with team efficiency metrics
Real-Time Data Sync powered by Supabase WebSockets
Smart Triage Inbox for ticket approval workflows
Spreadsheet-Style Bulk Dispatch for rapid ticket creation

projects.title: JO App — Job Order Mobile
projects.description: A Flutter-based mobile application designed for telecommunications field technicians to manage job orders and locate clients via Google Maps.
projects.longDescription: The technician-facing companion to the Dispatch Manager. Field technicians view assigned installation jobs, pinpoint client addresses on interactive Google Maps, and check nearby Network Access Point (NAP) box port availability — all from a clean, mobile-optimized interface.
highlights: Interactive Google Maps with client location pins
NAP box map with real-time port availability
Technician and Admin role-based views
REST API integration for live data sync
Clean bottom-navigation mobile UI

projects.title: SLR Ticket Monitoring System
projects.description: A premium Google Apps Script (GAS) solution for managing and monitoring service tickets across multiple municipalities.
projects.longDescription: Provides a streamlined interface for data entry, real-time validation, and automated reporting within Google Sheets. Features dynamic HTML/CSS sidebars, real-time dashboards for performance tracking, duplicate SF ticket prevention, and Salesforce integration to sync external data imports.
highlights: Dynamic custom HTML/CSS sidebars for data entry
Real-time Dashboard tracking performance and outages
Automated duplicate prevention for SF Tickets
Multi-Sheet Synchronization mapping to municipalities
Salesforce Integration for easy ticket import

projects.title: Job Tracker
projects.description: A sleek, modern Flutter application offering a centralized dashboard to track work hours and monitor production goals.
projects.longDescription: Built with Flutter, Firebase, and Material 3, the app provides a centralized dashboard for dynamic progress bars, a smart calendar for daily logs, and effortless logging sheets. Secure real-time data sync is powered by Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore, complemented by an auto-update checker.
highlights: Centralized Dashboard with customized dynamic progress bars
Smart Calendar view for daily logs management
Secure real-time data sync via Firebase Auth and Firestore
Effortless quick-access hour logging functionality
Auto-Update checker connected to Firestore config

projects.title: Automated Kaong Wine Brewing System
projects.description: An ESP32-powered automated brewing system designed to monitor and regulate sugar palm sap fermentation.
projects.longDescription: Developed as an undergraduate thesis to standardize traditional wine-making. The system uses a dual-ESP32 architecture (Controller and Sensor nodes) to coordinate pre-heating, PID-controlled thermal regulation (25–30°C) with quartz heaters and DC fans, yeast dosing, and pasteurization. Features wireless telemetry via the RAPT Pill hydrometer, localized SD logging, HX711 load cells, and a real-time network dashboard.
highlights: Dual-ESP32 architecture over custom UART communication link
PID temperature regulation with quartz infrared heaters & DC fans
Wireless Bluetooth/Wi-Fi telemetry using the RAPT Pill floating hydrometer
Volumetric yeast dosing via BTS7960 driver and 28BYJ-48 stepper motor
Standalone SPI SD Card logging with built-in CSV corruption prevention
Hardware protection including physical E-stop multiplexed via MCP23017 IO expander
Rigorous unit testing plan requiring 10 independent trials with >80% success rate

projects.title: B2B Lead Enrichment & Outreach Automation Hub
projects.description: A robust automation pipeline orchestrating Chrome browser actions, AppleScript, API integrations, and local data verification.
projects.longDescription: Built to streamline lead qualification for remote outreach campaigns. Designed a macOS-native execution loop that orchestrates browser automation (via AppleScript) to search corporate sites, queries Prospeo API for fallback personal emails, runs a local rule-based text scoring engine to verify leads, and syncs batches directly to a Google Sheets Lead Gen Hub. Implemented in-memory caching to bypass Google Sheets API rate-limiting.
highlights: Consolidated AppleScript and Chrome orchestration to bypass CAPTCHA checks
Batch synchronization to Google Sheets via service accounts with API rate-limit caching
Local, zero-cost keyword scoring engine replacing expensive external LLM API queries
Processed and deduplicated over 4,100 active leads for high-conversion outreach
Integrated Prospeo API fallback pipeline for personal email extraction

projects.title: Your Daily Kawaii — YouTube Shorts Channel
projects.description: A faceless short-form video channel built on a retention-first production pipeline, from sourcing and scripting through editing and analytics.
projects.longDescription: An independently operated YouTube Shorts channel where every upload runs through a repeatable pipeline: sourcing raw footage traced back to original posters, scripting on a hook–context–twist–payoff structure, AI voiceover synthesis, and retention-focused editing. Performance is iterated against view-versus-swipe-away and average-view-duration signals rather than vanity counts, and every upload is transformed enough to stay clear of YouTube's reused-content and inauthentic-content policies.
highlights: Retention-first scripting on a hook → context → twist → payoff structure
Editing for retention: dead-air removal, captions, sound design, and framing
AI voiceover synthesis via ElevenLabs with ideation support from Google AI Studio
Iteration driven by view-versus-swipe-away and average-view-duration signals
Rights-safe source transformation to stay within monetization policy
